design_gotchas.title: Hidden 26 V Supply Ceiling Trap When Swapping From 30 V/32 V LM358DR to 'Extended-Temp' LM2904DR!
design_gotchas.detail: Engineers routinely swap commercial LM358DR (0..70°C, 30 V op / 32 V abs max) to LM2904DR (-40..125°C) assuming identical voltage ratings—YET plain TI LM2904DR drops BOTH recommended and abs max supply to ONLY 26 V (±13 V, p.4–5) with zero overvoltage headroom! On 24 V+ industrial/±15 V rails, specify LM2904VDR (30 V/32 V) or next-gen LM2904BIDR (36 V/40 V).

design_gotchas.title: Legacy LM2904DR vs Next-Gen LM2904BIDR Confusion in Shared Datasheet (500 V vs 2000 V ESD, 7 mV vs 3 mV VOS)
design_gotchas.detail: Page 1 headlines 36 V supply, 300 uA/ch IQ, 1.2 MHz GBW, 3 mV VOS, ±2 kV HBM ESD, and internal EMI filters—ALL of which belong ONLY to the newer B/BA suffix (LM2904BIDR/LM2904BAIDR)! Legacy LM2904DR (Section 5.8, p.11) remains 26 V max, 0.7 MHz, 0.3 V/us, 7 mV max VOS (10 mV over temp), ±500 V HBM ESD, and no EMI filter.

design_gotchas.title: Pin-Identical SOIC-8 Swap Hazard Against Open-Collector LM2903DR / LM393DR Comparators
design_gotchas.detail: LM2904DR shares the exact 8-pin SOIC pinout (1=OUT1, 2=IN1-, 3=IN1+, 4=V-, 5=IN2+, 6=IN2-, 7=OUT2, 8=V+) with the dual comparator LM2903DR (-40..125°C, 36 V open-collector). Swapping LM2903DR into an LM2904DR linear op-amp socket causes oscillation and missing high-side drive; using LM2904DR as a fast comparator suffers slow 0.3 V/us recovery.

design_gotchas.title: Non-Rail-to-Rail Positive Ceiling (V+ - 2 V) & Weak 30 uA Sink Near Ground + Class-B Crossover
design_gotchas.detail: While PNP inputs sense down to V-, upper VCM stops at V+ - 2.0 V over -40°C..125°C (p.5, p.11) and positive output swing drops 2–4 V below V+ under load. Near ground (VO = 200 mV), non-V LM2904DR sinks only 30 uA typ (no guaranteed min listed on p.11 vs 12 uA min on V-suffix!) and exhibits classic Class-B crossover distortion.

typical_use_cases: Extended-temperature (-40°C to +125°C) 5 V–24 V low-side current sensing and ground-referenced DC control loops (strictly <= 26 V max including transients)
Industrial motor control, power supply feedback, and battery charger stages upgrading commercial 0..70°C LM358DR boards operating <= 24 V
Cost-sensitive legacy dual bipolar op-amp maintenance where designers should evaluate drop-in upgrade to 36 V / ±2 kV ESD LM2904BIDR
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments LM2904DR is the extended-temperature (-40°C to +125°C) industrial dual bipolar operational amplifier sibling of LM358DR in an 8-pin SOIC (D) package (RθJA = 124.7 °C/W), featuring ground-sensing PNP inputs, 0.7 MHz GBWP, 0.3 V/us slew rate, 350 uA/ch IQ, 20 nA input bias, and 7 mV max VOS (10 mV over temp). CRITICAL TRAP: Plain TI LM2904DR is strictly capped at 26 V (±13 V) for BOTH operating and absolute maximum supply—6 V lower than LM358DR (32 V) and 14 V lower than next-gen LM2904BIDR (40 V)—with only ±500 V HBM ESD; specify LM2904VDR (30 V) or LM2904BIDR (36 V) for 24 V+ or ±15 V rails.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision on p.3 confirmed Figure 4-1 D (SOIC-8) Top View pinout (1=OUT1, 2=IN1-, 3=IN1+, 4=V-, 5=IN2+, 6=IN2-, 7=OUT2, 8=V+).

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.4–5 confirmed critical legacy LM2904 rating limits: VS abs max = 26 V (±13 V) and rec op = 3–26 V (vs 30/32 V on LM358/LM2904V and 36/40 V on LM2904B), HBM ESD = ±500 V (vs ±2000 V on B), TA = -40..125°C, TJ = 150°C, and D-pkg Thermal Info (RθJA = 124.7 °C/W, RθJC(top) = 66.9 °C/W).

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.11 confirmed Section 5.8 legacy LM2904 specs (explicitly separated from Section 5.6 LM2904B p.8): VOS = 3/7 mV @ 25°C (10 mV over temp), CMRR = 80/65 dB, IB = -20/-250 nA (-500 nA over temp), en = 40 nV/rtHz, GBW = 0.7 MHz, SR = 0.3 V/us, ISC = ±40/±60 mA, and IQ = 350/600 uA/ch @ 5 V (500/1000 uA/ch @ 26 V).
